title: A Dust-trapping Ring in the Planet-hosting Disk of Elias 2-24
question: Is the bright ring at 78 au in the planet-hosting disk Elias 24 a dust trap, and what are the dust properties, turbulence and gas-to-dust ratio there?

data.bands: Band 3 (3 mm, new) and Band 6 (1.3 mm, DSHARP)
data.angular_resolution: 3 mm CLEAN 0.060"x0.058"; 1.3 mm CLEAN 0.036"x0.034"; frank 29 mas (3 mm), 15 mas (1.3 mm)

evidence.quote: we employ their publicly available calibrated visibilities

what.value: Stellar luminosity L*=6 Lsun and its 0.2 dex uncertainty
Disk inclination and PA priors (29.0 deg, 45.7 deg) and 1.3 mm phase center

evidence.quote: we construct Gaussian priors using the the inclination and position angle values and $1\sigma$ uncertainties from (cite: Huang_DSHARPII_2018ApJ)

what.value: DSHARP dust opacities, grain density 1.675 g/cm3

evidence.quote: $\rho_m=1.675$ g cm$^{-3}$ is the average grain density (cite: birnstiel-DSHARP-scattering_2018ApJL)

recipe.goal: Calibrate and self-calibrate 3 mm data, image
recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, align executions to common phase center, self-calibrate short then combined baselines, tclean imaging
Fit 1-D radial brightness profile to deprojected visibilities with Gaussian process; point-source at phase center subtracted; 5000 fits for uncertainties
key_parameters: Rmax=2.1", N=300, p0=1e-15 Jy^2, alpha=1.3, wsmooth=0.1
assumptions: Axisymmetric emission; i=29 deg, PA=45.7 deg

recipe.method: Convolve 1.3 mm profile by 25 mas to 29 mas and compute alpha = log(I230/I100)/log(2.3)
Fit single Gaussian to ring B77, deconvolve width, compare w_d with pressure scale height; compute psi and alpha/St following Dullemond et al.
assumptions: Passive flared disk Td, phi=0.02, L*=6 Lsun, scaled by 0.5, mu=2.33, Sc=1, Gaussian rings

recipe.goal: Radiative transfer fit of Sigma_d, a_max, T_d
recipe.method: Scattering-included marginal probability analysis at each radius with DSHARP opacities using two bands
key_parameters: p=2.5 fixed (3.5 tested); Gaussian prior on Td with 11% width; a_max(r<50 au)>0.072 cm; IMF-like Sigma_d prior exponent -2.3

recipe.goal: Toomre Q, Stokes number and gas-to-dust ratio
recipe.method: Sample 1e6 draws of Sigma_d and T; compute Q and St assuming Sigma_g=100 Sigma_d; derive Sigma_g/Sigma_d in ring from tau, St and alpha/St with Q>2 stability

evidence.quote: we estimate a maximum gas-to-dust ratio of 27
$T_d(78 \ \mathrm{au}) = 11$ K and a pressure scale-height of $h_p(78 \ \mathrm{au}) = 5.15$ au
the emission is a factor of $0.003$ times the peak flux in the disk

not_stated_but_needed: tclean multiscale scales, image size, cell size, mask details
Which 3 mm SPWs/channels for continuum and any line-free selection
Model grids, sampling of the marginal probability (grid resolution, number of points) in the radiative transfer fit
Exact 1.3 mm CLEAN parameters (in DSHARP paper)
Exact self-calibration reference antenna, SNR thresholds
Fitting of Gaussian to ring: fitting method and weighting
missing_for_reproduction: Radiative transfer fitting code (Sierra et al. 2021) details and grids
score_reason: Public data and detailed frank settings, but the multiband fit code and several imaging parameters are not given.
rediscovery_reason: Data public, frank setup and formulas largely given, numeric results (ring widths, dust mass, gas-to-dust).
